explanation: The AI response failed to identify any of the correct Category 4 hurricanes for the 1990-1999 decade according to the ground truth (Bret, Douglas, Greg, Juliette, Kevin, Pauline). Instead, it provided a hallucinated/incorrect list of names (Eileen, Gilbert [which was 1988], Jose, Luis, Milena, Opal, Owen).
